entries.signature: New WSDefinitions(location : string [, user : string [, password : string [, proxy [, timeout : number [, secureConnection [, useOSAuthentication : boolean]]]]]])
entries.description:
A WSDL document, read when the value is made (WSОпределения). The location is a file path, or an http:// or https:// address, and it is loaded immediately. Location reads that address back. Services is an array of structures, one per wsdl:service: Name, NamespaceURI (the document's targetNamespace), and Ports, an array of structures with Name and Location (the soap:address).

A user and password are sent as Basic authentication. The timeout is a number of seconds from 1 to 120; left out, it is 30. An InternetProxy, a secure-connection object, and Windows authentication are refused — they are not applied: "WSDefinitions: an InternetProxy is not used from here", and the same shape for the other two. A missing file, a document that is not WSDL, and an HTTP answer other than success are refused by the location.
entries.parameters:
location — a file path or an http(s) URL.
user, password — optional Basic authentication.
timeout — seconds, 1 to 120. Left out, 30.
